title: A missing link: Brane networks and the Cobordism Conjecture
summary: The absence of global symmetries in a quantum gravity theory often requires the introduction of (new) symmetry-breaking defects, which appear as singular objects in the low-energy description. This has been formalized in the Cobordism Conjecture, which further relates the asymptotics of these defects to non-trivial deformation classes of the effective theory. In this work we investigate the symmetry-breaking defects for theories with a discrete symmetry $G$ encoded in the bordism groups $Ω^ξ_2 (BG)$ and, in particular, its sub-class described in terms of the homology groups…
